messages:
Evan (Sales): Quick handoff 1 SummitBridge closed yesterday. Main contacts: Noor (CTO) and Diego (Infra). They require VPC peering + SCIM/Okta, dedicated capacity target ~6 weeks out. Baseline ~3M tokens/mo, peak ~5.5M. Procurement is slow; flagging renewal-watch if PO > 60 days. Passing to CS for onboarding + Eng/Support for infra/runbook prep.

Rita (CS): Taking this. Ill run kickoff and own the 30/60 day plan. Please add billing contact and a short list of critical flows (chat, batch embeddings, webhooks). Any compliance asks?

Evan (Sales): Billing contact is Sam (RevOps) ccd. Critical flows: 1) low-latency chat (p95 target 300ms) 2) batched embedding jobs (large payloads) 3) async classification webhooks. They mentioned audit log retention and DPA requirements. Drive: https://drive.redwood/summit-plays.

Paul (Eng): Ill do VPC/peering + SSO feasibility. Need test CIDR, allowed egress ports (443 + 8443?), and which GPU family they prefer (A10 vs A100). ETA: 4 business days for initial precheck. Ill include recommended canary ramp and fallback model policy.

Ivy (Support): Ill draft the onboarding runbook and incident playbook. Starting checklist:
```
preflight:
  - verify peering (ping & traceroute)
  - SCIM user sync test
monitoring:
  - p95 latency <300ms chat
  - 5xx < 0.5%
escalation:
  - cs-oncall -> eng-oncall -> infra
```
Ill share v1 by Fri.

Sam (RevOps): Procurement asked for SOC2 & DPA. PO ETA ~3 wks but could be longer. Ill push and update here if delayed. Will tag renewal risk if PO >60d.

scheduler-bot: Kickoff scheduled Wed 11:00am PT "SummitBridge technical intake" (invitees: Evan, Rita, Paul, Ivy, Noor).

Rita (CS): Drafting kickoff doc with owners & due dates. Proposed owners: Rita (CS lead), Paul (Eng precheck), Ivy (Support runbook), Sam (RevOps/PO). Deadlines: precheck 4bd, runbook 3bd, kickoff Wed.

Evan (Sales): Ive added model info: redwood/opt-6b-quant, checkpoint ~8.2GB. Concurrency estimate 40 rps. Seq len typical 512 (chat), up to 2048 for batch.

Paul (Eng): Noted. Ill also include GPU hour estimates and memory footprint for procurement. Evan  can you drop expected max sequence and avg tokens per request in the doc?

Rita (CS): Summary: owners confirmed, timeline set, risks noted (procurement/SOC2). Action: team will reconvene after precheck; CS to run runbook drill week 2. Ill post updates here after kickoff. :thumbsup:
